stages.handoff:
The fault is in [IsAvailable](/app/lib/utils/ec2.go:120): it accepts any HTTP 200 from the metadata address, so a captive portal can pass the check. [Service startup](/app/lib/service/service.go:844) then reads `TeleportHostname` and can use the portal’s HTML as the node name.

The fix belongs in [ec2.go](/app/lib/utils/ec2.go:104): add variadic `InstanceMetadataClientOption` arguments and `WithIMDSClient`, then have `IsAvailable` retrieve `instance-id` through `getMetadata` under a 250 ms context and accept only `i-` followed by exactly 8 or 17 lowercase hex digits. The existing node ID validator includes an account prefix and is unsuitable for this check. Tests should cover valid IDs, HTML responses, retrieval errors, timeout, injection, and option errors.

I recorded the diagnosis in [checkpoint.md](/app/.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md). No project source or tests were edited: the specialist instructions for this task require fault localization only, so the requested fix remains unimplemented.

Updated [ec2.go](/app/lib/utils/ec2.go) so `IsAvailable` retrieves `instance-id` through the IMDS client with a 250 ms deadline and accepts only valid EC2 instance IDs. `NewInstanceMetadataClient` now accepts functional options, including `WithIMDSClient` for injection.

Added coverage in [ec2_test.go](/app/lib/utils/ec2_test.go) for valid IDs, captive portal HTML, malformed responses, retrieval errors, timeouts, and option errors. The focused `lib/utils` tests and `git diff --check` pass.

VERDICT: ACCEPT

The applied patch in [lib/utils/ec2.go](/app/lib/utils/ec2.go) meets the stated requirements. Availability now retrieves and validates the EC2 instance ID within a 250 ms timeout, and the constructor supports functional options, including an injected IMDS client. I found no correctness or regression defect.

Relevant existing tests passed:

- `GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test ./lib/utils -run 'TestInstanceMetadataClient|TestNewInstanceMetadataClientOptionError|TestIsEC2NodeID' -count=1`
- `GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test ./lib/utils -count=1`
- `GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test ./lib/labels/ec2 -count=1`

`git diff --check` also passed. No project code was changed during review.
